title: Fewest Leaps
commonMistakes: Adding one jump after already reaching the last marker
Choosing the farthest leap from only the current position rather than the whole layer
Returning 1 for a runway that starts on its final marker
Confusing the current layer boundary with the global farthest reach
followUps: How would you return one optimal sequence of landing positions?
What changes if each marker has a different jump cost?
How would you solve the problem if some markers are blocked?
attribution: Original problem by the Base Case contributors.
